facts.activity_file: setting, testing and sealing pressure relief devices

control_failures.control_label: controlled draining, venting and warm-through of steam systems

facts.title: near hit during start-up after maintenance on P-8301

response.consequence: The recorded outcome was no injury or loss. The potential outcome was rated 2 against the site's consequence scale, above the 0 actually realised.

defences.finding: Control STEAM_SYSTEM_WARM_THROUGH: the controlled draining, venting and warm-through of steam systems was not in place, and the accident investigation classified this as an absent or failed defence.

recommendations: Restore the controlled draining, venting and warm-through of steam systems on P-8301, M-8301 and TK-8310 and record the spot check before this task is next authorised.
response.sequence: Work was under way in verifying pressure relief and protection, specifically setting, testing and sealing pressure relief devices. P-8301 (reagent dosing pumps) is in service for reagent make-up and dosing. The task proceeded during start-up after maintenance while the controlled draining, venting and warm-through of steam systems was not in place. The pressure energy involved is held as hydraulic accumulator, and the recorded presentation was jet release, stored-energy discharge, rupture.
response.summary: On 4 October 2005 a near hit was recorded on P-8301, M-8301 and TK-8310 at Tolgarra Processing and Power Station during start-up after maintenance; pressure energy held as hydraulic accumulator was not released.
